mapper.select: select c.id, c.name, c.alias, c.tel, c.address from t_customer c where c.is_deleted = 0 and ( c.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or (c.alias is not null and c.alias != '' and c.alias like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or (c.tel is not null and c.tel != '' and c.tel like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or (c.address is not null and c.address != '' and c.address like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ) order by c.name limit #{limit}

select sku.id, sku.code, sku.name, sku.spec_name as specName, sku.unit, category.name as categoryName, sku.sale_price as salePrice from t_product_sku sku left join t_product_category category on sku.category_id = category.id where sku.is_deleted = 0 and ( sku.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or (sku.code is not null and sku.code != '' and sku.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or (sku.mnemonic_code is not null and sku.mnemonic_code != '' and sku.mnemonic_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or sku.id in ( select pa.sku_id from product_alias pa where pa.alias like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) order by sku.name limit #{limit}

select so.id, so.code, coalesce(customer.alias, customer.name) as customerName, cd.name as customerDeptName, so.delivery_date as deliveryDate, so.amount from t_sale_order so left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = so.customer_dept_id left join t_customer customer on customer.id = so.customer_id where so.is_deleted = 0 and ( so.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or customer.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or (customer.alias is not null and customer.alias != '' and customer.alias like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ) order by so.create_time desc, so.code desc limit #{limit}
